audit.why: Even lane (50.32% WR, 2033 games) that Qiyana dominates early and Viktor out-scales — text already frames it this way.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes text calls Viktor's E 'Death Ray' and his R 'Chaos Storm'; kit names are Hextech Ray and Arcane Storm. R also does not silence — it interrupts channels.
audit.why: Riot kit file is the authority on names.
audit.corrected: Hextech Ray (E), Arcane Storm (R); removed the silence claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing: Viktor's Q shield (9s->5s CD) absorbs Qiyana's opening burst and is an auto-reset tell; Qiyana's Q/R stun cancels his Arcane Storm channel; Gravity Field 17s->13s CD is the all-in gate.
audit.why: All present in kit flags and missingInteractions.

audit.corrected: Real CDs added: W 17/13s, Q 9/5s, E 12/8s, R 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.

edits.before: This is your window. Viktor is immobile with only Gravity Field (W) to peel, so brush-attune, E (Audacity) in and Q him before he stacks his upgrades. Bait or dodge his Death Ray (E) — it's his poke and waveclear — then all-in while his W is on cooldown to snowball the lane early.
edits.after: This is your window. Viktor is immobile with only Gravity Field (W, 17s early) to peel, so brush-attune, E (Audacity) in and Q him before he stacks his upgrades. Bait or dodge his Hextech Ray (E) — his poke and waveclear — then all-in while his W is down to snowball the lane early.

edits.before: You still hold the all-in at 6: E-R into a wall detonation kills him before Chaos Storm ramps. Respect Gravity Field — if you dash in and stand in the zone it stuns you — so approach from an angle and burst before the slow builds. Kill him now to deny his item timings.
edits.after: You still hold the all-in at 6: E-R into a wall detonation kills him before Arcane Storm ramps. Respect Gravity Field — if you dash in and stand in the zone it stuns you — so approach from an angle and burst before the slow builds. Kill him now to deny his item timings.

edits.before: Your first assassin item lets you delete him before he completes his core. Keep dying-Viktor off farm and deny his Death Ray waveclear stacks; every kill here delays the hextech spike that flips the matchup against you.
edits.after: Your first assassin item lets you delete him before he completes his core. Keep Viktor off farm and deny his Hextech Ray waveclear stacks; every kill here delays the hextech spike that flips the matchup against you.

edits.before: Once Viktor has two-plus items he out-scales you — Chaos Storm silence, Gravity Field stun, and Death Ray zoning let him kite and burst you in teamfights. You must have snowballed the early game; if it's even, he wins the late. Look for flank picks from stealth instead of straight engages.
edits.after: Once Viktor has two-plus items he out-scales you — Arcane Storm damage, Gravity Field stun, and Hextech Ray zoning let him kite and burst you in teamfights. You must have snowballed the early game; if it's even, he wins the late. Look for flank picks from stealth instead of straight engages.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 you pressure him — Viktor is a weak, immobile laner before his upgrades, and your Royal Privilege first-hit plus W move speed win short trades. Deny his early Death Ray farm and set up the level-3 all-in.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 you pressure him — Viktor is a weak, immobile laner before his upgrades, and your Royal Privilege first-hit plus W move speed win short trades. Deny his early Hextech Ray farm and set up the level-3 all-in.

edits.after: Levels 3-6 are your dominant phase. E-Q-W bursts him down and at 6 your R wall-slam finishes before Arcane Storm matters; his only answer is Gravity Field, so engage from an angle and kill him repeatedly to starve his item timings. This is where you must build your lead.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it.
